step1_analysis.circuit_type: Direct-Conversion Quadrature Mixer (Merged LNA and Mixer)
step1_analysis.description: A double-balanced quadrature (I/Q) mixer with a merged common-gate RF input stage. It downconverts a differential RF signal to baseband I and Q signals using quadrature LO signals.

conversion_gain.description: Voltage conversion gain from RF input to IF output

sky130_expected.calculation: Vov = 0.54V - 0.42V = 0.12V. Id = 0.5 * 270u * (5/0.5) * 0.12^2 = 19.4uA. gm = 2*Id/Vov = 323uS. Assuming 10kOhm load resistors, Gain = (2/pi) * gm * Rload = 0.636 * 323u * 10k = 2.05 V/V = 6.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 47 dB for the entire receiver chain. The mixer alone with the given bias and 10k loads provides around 6 dB.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the mixer stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the provided VBIAS of 0.54V and W/L=10, the current is very low compared to the full receiver power, which includes LO buffers and baseband amplifiers.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mixer NF is typically high, dominated by the switching quad and the low gm of the input stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 28 dB NF for the receiver, which is typical for low-power sensor applications.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the linearity of the common-gate stage and the switching quad.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value of -21 dBm.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure conversion gain and power consumption of the quadrature mixer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Quadrature Mixer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 IF_Ip LO_In N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 IF_In LO_Ip N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IF_Qp LO_Qn N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 IF_Qn LO_Qp N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 VBIAS N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 IF_Qp LO_Qp N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 VBIAS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 IF_Ip LO_Ip N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 IF_In LO_In N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 IF_Qn LO_Qn N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.54

* IF Load Resistors
R1 IF_Ip VDD 10k
R2 IF_In VDD 10k
R3 IF_Qp VDD 10k
R4 IF_Qn VDD 10k

* RF Inputs (2.401 GHz)
VRF_p N10 0 DC 0 SIN(0 10m 2.401G 0 0 0)
VRF_n N2 0 DC 0 SIN(0 10m 2.401G 0 0 180)

* LO Inputs (2.4 GHz Quadrature)
VLO_Ip LO_Ip 0 DC 1.0 SIN(1.0 0.5 2.4G 0 0 0)
VLO_In LO_In 0 DC 1.0 SIN(1.0 0.5 2.4G 0 0 180)
VLO_Qp LO_Qp 0 DC 1.0 SIN(1.0 0.5 2.4G 0 0 90)
VLO_Qn LO_Qn 0 DC 1.0 SIN(1.0 0.5 2.4G 0 0 270)

* Behavioral sources for differential IF
B1 IF_I_diff 0 V=v(IF_Ip)-v(IF_In)
B2 IF_Q_diff 0 V=v(IF_Qp)-v(IF_Qn)

.control
  * Run transient analysis for 5us (5 periods of 1MHz IF)
  tran 10p 5u
  
  * Measure power consumption
  meas tran I_VDD avg i(VVDD) from=2u to=5u
  let power = -I_VDD * 1.8
  print power
  
  * Measure Conversion Gain (I channel)
  meas tran IF_I_max max v(IF_I_diff) from=2u to=5u
  meas tran IF_I_min min v(IF_I_diff) from=2u to=5u
  let IF_I_pp = IF_I_max - IF_I_min
  * RF input is 20mV peak differential -> 40mV peak-to-peak
  let conv_gain_I = IF_I_pp / 0.04
  let conv_gain_I_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain_I)
  print conv_gain_I_db
  
  * Measure Conversion Gain (Q channel)
  meas tran IF_Q_max max v(IF_Q_diff) from=2u to=5u
  meas tran IF_Q_min min v(IF_Q_diff) from=2u to=5u
  let IF_Q_pp = IF_Q_max - IF_Q_min
  let conv_gain_Q = IF_Q_pp / 0.04
  let conv_gain_Q_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain_Q)
  print conv_gain_Q_db
  
  quit
.endc
.end
